submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. LOCAL FOOT DIRECTION CORRECTION on input1 cast East frame09. Character faces SCREEN RIGHT. Keep EXACTLY the original image above both knees: head expression hair crown torso robe arms bell five-card fan, pose and pixel sizes must not change. Keep hips/knee locations, knee bends, stance width, foot support positions and virtual floor height. Repaint only lower shins, ankles and shoes so BOTH SHOES point to SCREEN RIGHT along the same direction as the face. Rear shoe at SCREEN LEFT currently points toward viewer/down-left and splays outward; rotate its anatomy in three dimensions at the ankle so its HEEL is LEFT and its TOE is RIGHT, showing its side profile, matching the forward shoe's heel-to-toe axis. Reconnect rear knee-shin-ankle naturally. Forward screen-right shoe also rightwards, both roughly parallel, no toe-out, no V stance. Do not narrow stance to fake correction. Preserve red/black/gold shoe design and grounded flat soles, virtual ground y920 at1024. Keep fixed canvas registration and scale. Other refs portrait identity, E idle direction, approved style only. Single native square>=1024 RGBA actual transparency; no floor/shadow/labels/effects.
